warmstone.name: Warm Stone
notes: A warm stone, grey on top and red underneath. It ticks as it cools in your hand.
Another warm stone. Something under the downs is breathing out through it.

rimeberry.name: Rimeberry
notes: A rimeberry bush, every berry sealed in clear ice. They keep all winter, if the wolves leave them.
More rimeberries. The snow round them is trodden flat by something that comes to eat.

marshlamp.name: Marsh Lamp
notes: A marsh lamp: a hollow reed with a cold yellow flame in it. It leans away from the wind.
Another marsh lamp, lit by nobody. The reeds round it have been bent flat, as if by a path.

cairnlight.name: Cairn Light
notes: A cairn light: a pale flame on a heap of stones, burning with no fuel and giving no heat.
Another cairn light. Its flame points at the biggest mound, like a finger.

witchfire.name: Witch Fire
notes: A witch fire: green flame on a rotten stump, flickering in no wind. It hisses when you step near.
Another witch fire. The water round it is perfectly still, and shows a different sky.

slagglass.name: Slag Glass
notes: A shard of slag glass, black outside and glowing orange when you hold it to the light.
More slag glass, still warm. The smiths who made it must have left in a hurry.

crownshard.name: Crown Shard
notes: A shard of an iron crown, black with age. It is far heavier than it should be.
Another crown shard. Held next to the first, the two pull at each other.

lore.way: the red track that climbs inland from The Cinder Coast onto the grey scrub of The Ashen Downs

sign.cinder_coast: Hounds from The Ashen Downs follow the traders down to the shore and sleep on the warm sand.
sign.ashen_downs: The wind from The Cinder Coast smells of smoke and salt, and the hounds lift their heads to it.

lore.way: the drovers' way from the green edge of The Thornwood up onto the ash of The Ashen Downs

sign.ashen_downs: Beasts from The Thornwood come up to the downs at night, and come back singed.
sign.thornwood: Ash blows down off The Ashen Downs and greys the thorn leaves by morning.

lore.way: the scorched ramp that climbs from The Ashen Downs to the rim of The Ember Caldera

sign.ashen_downs: The ground of The Ashen Downs grows warmer every step toward The Ember Caldera, and the hounds will not follow.
sign.ember_caldera: Hot ash pours off The Ember Caldera and has buried the old road to The Ashen Downs a hand deep.

lore.way: the black-glass road from the vents of The Ashen Downs to the smelters of The Slagfields

sign.ashen_downs: The vents of The Ashen Downs glow brighter each night, and the glow points toward The Slagfields.
sign.slagfields: Smoke from the smelters of The Slagfields rolls down over The Ashen Downs and stays.

lore.way: the steaming gully where the ash of The Ashen Downs runs into the snow of The Rimewood

sign.ashen_downs: Meltwater runs out of The Rimewood across the downs, and the ash drinks it and turns to paste.
sign.rimewood: The pines at the edge of The Rimewood are dripping, and wolves come to the warm side to sleep.

lore.way: the cracked mud flats between The Ashen Downs and the dying reeds of The Reedmere

sign.ashen_downs: The pools at the edge of The Reedmere are drying up, and things come up out of them toward the downs.
sign.reedmere: Fumes from The Ashen Downs have yellowed the reeds, and the frogs have gone quiet.

lore.way: the long causeway where the hot red earth of The Ashen Downs gives way to the ice of The Frostfen

sign.ashen_downs: The meres of The Frostfen are thawing from the south, and the ash is running into them.
sign.frostfen: Mist rises where The Ashen Downs meets the ice, and the hounds there have thick winter coats in summer.

lore.way: the iced trail from the pines of The Rimewood out onto the meres of The Frostfen

sign.rimewood: Frost from The Frostfen lies on the pine roots here, and it is the wrong kind of cold.
sign.frostfen: The wolves of The Rimewood cross the ice at dusk and the yetis watch them go.

lore.way: the snowed-under logging road from The Thornwood up into the white pines of The Rimewood

sign.rimewood: Snow is lying in the north of The Thornwood in high summer, and it is creeping south a few paces a week.
sign.thornwood: Thorns have started to grow up through the snow at the edge of The Rimewood, which they should not.

lore.way: the frozen bank where the bog of The Mirewood runs up into the pines of The Rimewood

sign.mirewood: The pools of The Mirewood are skinned with ice before noon, and the cold comes from The Rimewood.
sign.rimewood: Fog from The Mirewood freezes on the pine needles, and each tree wears a white cloak.

lore.way: the long white road inland from the warm shore of The Cinder Coast to The Rimewood

sign.cinder_coast: Snow from The Rimewood melts on the hot sand of The Cinder Coast, and the hissing carries for miles.
sign.rimewood: The edge of The Rimewood is a muddy slush, and every drip is warm.

lore.way: the wolf run that climbs out of the pines of The Rimewood to the burial mounds of The Hoarfrost Cairns

sign.rimewood: The wolves of The Rimewood will not go near The Hoarfrost Cairns, even when they are starving.
sign.hoarfrost: The pines of The Rimewood grow right up to the cairns, and their roots go into the graves.

lore.way: the iced boardwalk from The Mistmoor through the first pines of The Rimewood

sign.rimewood: The black pools of The Mistmoor are freezing at their rims, and things are trapped in the ice.
sign.mistmoor: Mist from The Mistmoor rolls up through the pines of The Rimewood and freezes on every branch.

lore.way: the plank walk that crosses the water from The Mirewood into the tall reeds of The Reedmere

sign.mirewood: Reed cutters come in from The Reedmere with news of lights that move against the wind.
sign.reedmere: The ground goes soft under the reeds of The Reedmere: that is The Mirewood beginning.

lore.way: the black causeway that runs from the fen of The Reedmere to the drowned chapel of The Mistmoor

sign.reedmere: Something has been walking up from The Mistmoor through the reeds, and the reeds are bent in rows.
sign.mistmoor: The water of The Mistmoor is rising, and every bubble that comes up from The Reedmere smells of graves.

lore.way: the rotten corduroy road that winds from the open fen of The Reedmere into the black trees of The Witchmire

sign.reedmere: Marsh lamps lead travellers from The Reedmere off the road, toward The Witchmire, and not all come back.
sign.witchmire: The reeds of The Reedmere have started to glow green at the edge of The Witchmire.

lore.way: the drovers' causeway from the dry green of The Thornwood down into the fen of The Reedmere

sign.reedmere: Every cattle drive out of The Thornwood loses a beast to The Reedmere, and no one can say how.
sign.thornwood: Beyond the reeds of The Reedmere, hunters say, the ground rises into the thorns of The Thornwood.

lore.way: the ash-grey salt flats between The Cinder Coast and the steaming fen of The Reedmere

sign.cinder_coast: The fen of The Reedmere steams in the morning as if the water were being boiled from below.
sign.reedmere: The coast wind carries ash into The Reedmere, and the reeds are wearing grey.

lore.way: the sunken path that climbs from the black water of The Reedmere to the mound field of The Barrow

sign.reedmere: The dead of The Barrow have been walking down into the fen, and the fen has been walking them back.
sign.barrow: Fen water has soaked into the mounds of The Barrow from The Reedmere, and the old stones lean.

lore.way: the frozen cairn road that runs from The Hoarfrost Cairns to the standing stones of The Barrow

sign.hoarfrost: The cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns and the mounds of The Barrow were raised by the same hands, and are waking together.
sign.barrow: Rime has spread from The Hoarfrost Cairns over the oldest stones of The Barrow, and the names on them are gone.

lore.way: the rimed causeway between the frozen meres of The Frostfen and the cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns

sign.hoarfrost: Bones surface in the meres of The Frostfen after every thaw, and they are all from The Hoarfrost Cairns.
sign.frostfen: The ice at the foot of the cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns is thick as stone and black as slate.

lore.way: the half-frozen track that drops from the cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns into the black pools of The Witchmire

sign.hoarfrost: Witch fires have been seen on the cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns, burning green on the ice.
sign.witchmire: The pools of The Witchmire freeze at the rim by the cairns, and what is under the ice is not fish.

lore.way: the king's road, paved in black stone, from the cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns to the ruined halls of The Ironcrown

sign.hoarfrost: The old kings of The Ironcrown are said to have been buried here, in the cold, so that they would keep.
sign.ironcrown: The mounds at the edge of The Ironcrown are rimed, and the guards of the dead king are cold to the touch.

lore.way: the steaming stair where the rime of The Hoarfrost Cairns meets the black glass of The Slagfields

sign.hoarfrost: The cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns are dripping on the side that faces The Slagfields, and the dead do not like it.
sign.slagfields: Hoarfrost crusts the slag at the edge of The Slagfields, and the smelters hiss and spit.

lore.way: the cracked ridge between the ice of The Hoarfrost Cairns and the rim of The Ember Caldera

sign.hoarfrost: Steam climbs from the ridge between The Hoarfrost Cairns and The Ember Caldera, and the snow there is grey.
sign.ember_caldera: The cairns of The Hoarfrost Cairns look down on The Ember Caldera, and the lava glows on their ice.

lore.way: the flooded lane that leads from the standing stones of The Witchmire to the drowned chapel of The Mistmoor

sign.witchmire: The mist of The Mistmoor thickens near the ring of stones, and the stones are humming.
sign.mistmoor: The bells of the drowned chapel in The Mistmoor ring at night, and are answered from The Witchmire.

lore.way: the tangled track that climbs from the black pools of The Witchmire to the mounds of The Barrow

sign.witchmire: What the ring in The Witchmire calls up, it sends up the track to The Barrow.
sign.barrow: Black water seeps out of the mounds of The Barrow toward The Witchmire, and the dead follow it down.

lore.way: the sunken causeway from the stones of The Witchmire to the broken gates of The Ironcrown

sign.witchmire: The witches of The Witchmire swore a bargain with the iron king once, and the stones remember it.
sign.ironcrown: Green fire burns in the windows of the ruins of The Ironcrown, and it is the same green as The Witchmire's.

lore.way: the singed trail from the dead trees of The Witchmire up to the black rim of The Ember Caldera

sign.witchmire: The pools of The Witchmire are shrinking, and the mud at their edges is baked hard as brick.
sign.ember_caldera: The wind off The Witchmire is wet and cold, and it hisses where it meets the heat of The Ember Caldera.

lore.way: the smelters' ramp from The Slagfields up to the molten heart of The Ember Caldera

sign.slagfields: All the lava of The Slagfields flows down from The Ember Caldera, and tonight it flows faster.
sign.ember_caldera: The Warden's smiths of The Slagfields drew their fire from the lake of The Ember Caldera, and the lake remembers.

lore.way: the black glass road from the furnaces of The Slagfields to the broken gates of The Ironcrown

sign.slagfields: The smiths of The Slagfields forged the iron crown for the king of The Ironcrown, and are said to have been buried with it.
sign.ironcrown: The ruins of The Ironcrown glow orange at their foundations, as if something were still being forged under them.

lore.way: the glass-paved road from The Slagfields to the standing stones of The Barrow

sign.slagfields: Slag has run into the foot of the mounds of The Barrow, and the dead there walk about in half-melted armour.
sign.barrow: The standing stones of The Barrow glow cherry red on the side that faces The Slagfields.

lore.way: the old processional way from the ruined halls of The Ironcrown to the mounds of The Barrow

sign.ironcrown: The dead lord of The Barrow was the king's champion, and he is walking toward The Ironcrown to guard it again.
sign.barrow: The mounds of The Barrow have been opened from the inside, and the road to The Ironcrown is trodden bare.

lore.way: the flooded king's road from The Mistmoor up to the ruined gate of The Ironcrown

sign.ironcrown: The drowned chapel of The Mistmoor was the king's own, and its bell rings toward The Ironcrown.
sign.mistmoor: Black water has crept up the king's road to the gate of The Ironcrown, and the guards stand in it.

lore.way: a narrow slag gully off The Slagfields
a snow-choked cleft off The Rimewood
a rimed burial passage off The Hoarfrost Cairns
a boggy side channel off The Reedmere
a half-drowned lane off The Witchmire
a crumbling stair off The Ironcrown
a moss-hung path off The Witchmire
a steaming ravine off The Ashen Downs

pilgrims_bell.title: The Pilgrims' Bell
welcome: A bell has been tolling in the night over {r1}, thinner every week. {keeper} is waiting to tell you what it means.

chapters.title: The Thin Bell
intro: You heard it too? The bell. Half a year ago a band of pilgrims left this camp carrying it, to ring the restless dead to sleep along the old road.
I am {keeper}. They have not come back, and the bell grows fainter. Help me hold {r1}, and then we will follow it.
You heard the bell, then. Good: most people have learned not to listen.
I am {keeper}. Half a year ago pilgrims took it out along the old road to ring the dead to sleep, and it has been getting fainter ever since. Help me hold {r1}, and then we go after it.

quests.learned: The {r1.common.lower} come close because the bell no longer keeps them away.
fieldNote: The last one slinks off, ears flat, as if it had heard something far away.
quests.title: Keep the Camp
offer: With the bell fading, the {r1.common.lower} come right up to the fires. Drive off five of them.
done: Quieter. But the quiet has a hole in it, where the bell used to be.

quests.learned: The pilgrims set {r1.site.plural} along the road as beacons, and they are guttering one by one.
fieldNote: Three of them, burning low, and every flame leans the same way: out along the pilgrims' road.
quests.title: Count the Beacons
quests.hint: {r1.site.plural} lie about {r1}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The pilgrims left {r1.site.plural} to mark their way. Touch three and see how they burn.
done: Low, all of them, and leaning outward. The road they took is the only road there is.
Take this draught; the first mile is the worst.

quests.learned: The pilgrims rested in {r2} and left {r2.site.plural} to mark the spot.
fieldNote: Three of them, set in a ring with the ashes of a fire in the middle. They stopped here, and left in a hurry.
quests.title: Where They Rested
quests.hint: {r2.site.plural} lie about {r2}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: Pilgrims leave signs where they rest. Touch three {r2.site.lower} in {r2} and tell me which way they went.
done: They left in a hurry, and the tracks go on past the edge of {r2}.
Rest a moment. Then onward.

fieldNote: Each one has the ground round it trodden by feet that did not walk away.
Each one stands ringed in meltwater: whoever set them stood in snow, and the ground is waking.
Each one wears frost creeping over its base like a slow hand.
Each one is scorched black on one side, as if a great heat passed over.
Each one burns blue with cold, which gives no light to read by.
Each one is set tidy as a milestone, by hands that expected to come back.

quests.learned: The {r3.ranged.lower} were set to watch the road: something wants the pilgrims' trail left unwalked.
fieldNote: The last one falls and the bell, very faint, tolls once from somewhere ahead.
quests.title: Break the Watch
offer: The {r3.ranged.lower} of {r3} strike from afar at anyone on the pilgrims' road. Break four of them.
done: Then the way is open. Whatever rang that bell is further on.

quests.learned: The pilgrims set {r4.site.plural} here to show the way in the dark, and then something snuffed half of them.
fieldNote: Three in a row, set by hand. Whoever put them here wanted to be found.
quests.title: Count the Candles
quests.hint: {r4.site.plural} lie about {r4}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: Pilgrims mark the road with {r4.site.plural}. Touch three in {r4} and learn what happened to them.
done: Half of them snuffed out, and the rest bent toward the road. They were taken along it.

fieldNote: Each one has the ground round it trodden by feet that did not walk away.
Each one stands ringed in meltwater: whoever set them stood in snow, and the ground is waking.
Each one wears frost creeping over its base like a slow hand.
Each one is scorched black on one side, as if a great heat passed over.
Each one burns blue with cold, which gives no light to read by.
Each one is set tidy as a milestone, by hands that expected to come back.

quests.learned: The {r5.brute.lower} are no wild things: they stand where the pilgrims were last seen, and do not move for food.
fieldNote: The third one falls, and its fellows stop and stare at the road, as if they had been waiting for you to finish.
quests.title: Break the Wardens
offer: Three {r5.brute.lower} are blocking the road through {r5}. Break them, and see what they were guarding.
done: They were guarding something. The tracks run on, deeper.

quests.learned: The pilgrims chanted at the {r6.site.lower}, and they hold the words, faintly, for anyone who touches one.
fieldNote: Four of them, each humming one line of a hymn. Together they spell out the bell's name.
quests.title: Read the Litany

fieldNote: Each one has the ground round it trodden by feet that did not walk away.
Each one stands ringed in meltwater: whoever set them stood in snow, and the ground is waking.
Each one wears frost creeping over its base like a slow hand.
Each one is scorched black on one side, as if a great heat passed over.
Each one burns blue with cold, which gives no light to read by.
Each one is set tidy as a milestone, by hands that expected to come back.

quests.learned: The {r7.brute.lower} guarded the bell from the pilgrims, and now they guard it from everyone.
fieldNote: The last guard falls. The air is utterly still, as if the whole land were listening.
quests.title: The Last Guards
offer: Whatever has the bell is not alone. Break three of the {r7.brute.lower} that stand about {r7}.
done: Now only the one that took it is left.

quests.learned: The {r7.boss} took the bell to ring the dead awake, not asleep. It will ring no more.
fieldNote: The {r7.boss} falls, and the bell rolls from its grip and tolls once, clear and loud, across the whole country.
quests.title: Ring Them Down
offer: The {r7.boss} has the pilgrims' bell. End it, and let the bell ring true again.
done: It rings! I can hear it from here. The dead are lying down.
Take this. It was a pilgrim's, once.

epilogue: The bell is silent. In the quiet, you can hear how far you have come.
Rest, if you can. The road remembers every one of you.

quests.learned: The {r1.common.lower} crowd the fires: the cold is driving everything toward warmth.
fieldNote: The last one backs off, steaming, and stands shivering at the edge of the light.
quests.title: Hold the Hearths
offer: The {r1.common.lower} crowd the fires, wanting warmth. Drive off five before they spoil the stores.
done: They will come back when it gets colder. We should not be here when it does.

quests.learned: The frost lies thickest on the {r1.site.plural}, as though they were the first thing it touched.
fieldNote: Three of them, each rimed in a spiral that points the same way.
quests.title: Measure the Frost
quests.hint: {r1.site.plural} lie about {r1}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The frost came first to the {r1.site.plural}. Touch three of them and tell me how thick it lies.
done: Thick as a thumb, and all of it pointing out of the camp.
Take this: it is warmer than it looks.

quests.learned: The winter walked past the {r2.site.plural} and left each one white.
fieldNote: Three of them, white and ringing, and between them a line of bare prints, none of them ever stepping twice in one place.
quests.title: Mark the Prints
quests.hint: {r2.site.plural} lie about {r2}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The tracks pass the {r2.site.plural} of {r2}. Touch three of them, and learn how long ago it passed.
done: Not long. It is a day ahead of us, no more.

fieldNote: Each one stands over a shallow grave, frozen shut, with a bare print leading away from it.
Each one drips, and the drips freeze again before they reach the ground.
Each one is furred white, from the side the frost came.
Each one is cracked from heat on one side and from cold on the other.
Each one is ringed with ice thick as a wrist, glittering, utterly still.
Each one is rimed over, like the milestones along it.

quests.learned: The {r3.ranged.lower} are the winter's outriders: they loose the cold as arrows, from far off.
fieldNote: The last one falls, and the wind drops, for a heartbeat, before it comes back.
quests.title: Break the Wind
offer: The {r3.ranged.lower} of {r3} harry travellers from the white. Break four of them.
done: The wind is a little gentler. Not by much.

quests.learned: The winter put out every fire in {r4} but the ones in the {r4.site.plural}.

quests.hint: {r4.site.plural} lie about {r4}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: A little warmth is left in the {r4.site.plural} of {r4}. Touch three of them and take it with you.
done: Warm. A little, but warm. It will have to carry us.

quests.learned: The {r9.boss} was the winter's heart, and it walked because it was too cold to stand still.

quests.title: End the Winter
offer: The {r9.boss} is the winter itself, in a shape you can strike. End it.
done: Warm! Can you feel it? The snow is already running.
Take this, from my own chest. You have more use for it than I.

Winter will come again, in its season, and be only winter. Rest. You walked a long way.

crown_road.title: The Crown Road
welcome: A crown of iron was broken into pieces, and pieces are turning up all over the country. {keeper} is waiting in {r1} to tell you who wants them.

chapters.title: A Broken Crown
intro: You are here about the crown? Everyone is, now.

I am {keeper}. An iron crown was broken a hundred years ago and its shards scattered. Someone is gathering them, and they will wear it again. Help me hold {r1}, and then we go after them, shard by shard.

quests.learned: The {r1.common.lower} are not the Heir's, but they follow the Heir's men for scraps.
fieldNote: The last one slinks off after a rider who was never there.
quests.title: Hold the Gate
offer: Strangers have been through, and the {r1.common.lower} follow them in. Drive off five before they settle.
done: The riders are gone, but the road they took leads out of {r1}. We follow.

quests.learned: The first shard was hidden among the {r1.site.plural}: the Heir's men dug up half of them looking.
fieldNote: Three of them, each dug up and replanted in the wrong place.
quests.title: Search the Camp
quests.hint: {r1.site.plural} lie about {r1}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The Heir's men searched the camp for a shard. Touch three {r1.site.lower} and see what they missed.
done: The shard was in the third, under a stone. They missed it, and we did not.
Take this draught. You will need it where we are going.

quests.learned: The {r2.common.lower} here have taken the Heir's coin: fierce things, but cheap.
fieldNote: The fifth one falls, a purse of Heir's coin spilling from its harness.
quests.title: Break the Hirelings
offer: The Heir has paid the {r2.common.lower} of {r2} to guard the road. Drive off five of them.
done: The road is open. The coin is the Heir's, and the Heir is richer than any of us.

quests.learned: The second shard is hidden in {r3}, among the {r3.site.plural}, where only a lover of that place would look.
fieldNote: Three of them, and under the third a shard of black iron, humming.
quests.title: Find the Second Shard
quests.hint: {r3.site.plural} lie about {r3}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: A shard is hidden in {r3}, among the {r3.site.plural}. Touch three of them, and you will find it.
done: Two shards now. They hum when they are close, like struck glass.

fieldNote: Something has dug at the foot of each one, and given up.
Each one has a hoof-print in the mud beside it, and the mud is already freezing.
Each one wears a collar of frost, like a ring drawn round a thing that must not be moved.
Each one is warm, as if the shard had lain on it and cooked.
Each one is ringed with the prints of cold hands.
Each one is trodden flat round the base, by many boots.

quests.learned: The {r4.ranged.lower} of {r4} are hired, and fight like it: from afar, and ready to run.
fieldNote: The last one throws down its bow and runs, shouting that it was not paid enough.
quests.title: Cut the Bought Swords
offer: The Heir has paid the {r4.ranged.lower} of {r4} to shoot at anyone who looks like a shard-hunter. Break four of them.
done: They will tell no one. We have a day, perhaps, before the Heir learns.

quests.learned: The third shard lies where the {r5.site.plural} grow thickest in {r5}.
fieldNote: Three of them, and under the last a shard that is warm, as though someone had held it a moment ago.
quests.title: Find the Third Shard
quests.hint: {r5.site.plural} lie about {r5}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The third shard is among the {r5.site.plural} of {r5}. Touch three, and look under the last.
done: Three shards, and the hum is a chord now.
The Heir is close. I can feel them looking.

quests.learned: The {r6.brute.lower} are the Heir's best: the ones paid to be fearless, who have learned to be.
fieldNote: The third one falls, and the Heir's banner on the ridge goes down with it.
quests.title: Break the Heir's Champions
offer: The Heir's strongest, the {r6.brute.lower}, hold {r6}. Break three of them.
done: The road is ours. Their champions are down, and there will be no more.

quests.learned: The last free shard is in {r7}, hidden in plain sight among the {r7.site.plural}.
fieldNote: Three of them, and under the last a shard that flares as you lift it, bright as a signal.
quests.title: Find the Fourth Shard
quests.hint: {r7.site.plural} lie about {r7}: look beside the trails and the water.
offer: The last free shard lies among the {r7.site.plural} of {r7}. Touch three of them and take it before the Heir does.
done: Four shards. The Heir has the rest, and knows where we are: that flare was seen for miles.

quests.learned: The {r8.brute.lower} of {r8} are the Heir's last guard, and they know the Heir has everything to lose.
fieldNote: The last of them falls, and the Heir stands alone, with the crown half-made in their hands.
quests.title: The Heir's Guard
offer: The {r8.brute.lower} stand between you and the Heir in {r8}. Break three of them.
done: Now only the Heir.

quests.learned: The {r8.boss} wore the iron crown, and the crown wore it. Both are done.
fieldNote: The {r8.boss} falls, and the iron crown breaks again in the dust, and this time it stays broken.
quests.title: Unmake the Crown
offer: The {r8.boss} has put the crown together and wears it. Take it off.
done: The shards are scattered again, and I will see that no one finds them.
Take this: it is what the crown was made to buy.
The shards went to slag in the fire, which is best.
Take this: it is what the crown was made to buy.
The dead king has his crown back, in pieces, and the dead will keep it now.
Take this: it is what the crown was made to buy.

epilogue: The shards are scattered again, and the road is only a road.
Someone will start collecting them in a hundred years. Not your problem. Rest.
